title: Obvara Raku Firing Workshop – November 15, 2026
host_org: Clay Creations at Oribe Firing Center
bring: 3–5 bisque-fired pieces suitable for the process
source_quote: Obvara is a raku-style atmospheric firing technique that uses fermented mixtures to create unpredictable surface patterns and smoky organic finishes on ceramics.
evidence_sentence: The Artist Workshops page lists the Obvara Firing Workshop on Nov 15, 2026 as a hands-on raku-style atmospheric firing at Oribe Firing Center.
evidence_quote: Obvara is a raku-style atmospheric firing technique
summary: Obvara Firing Workshop is a hands-on raku atmospheric firing on Nov 15, 2026 (9am–3pm) at Oribe Firing Center led by Julia Kaefer. No prior Obvara experience needed. Participants bring 3–5 bisque-fired pieces. Cost: $120 non-members, $95 members.
how_to_join: Email [email protected] or call (650) 557-0683 for availability and registration after event listing goes live.
